title: The Retro Multicolor Christmas Kitchen Hutch
description: A retro multicolor Christmas kitchen hutch from Walmart: a light-up ceramic Christmas tree, multicolor ball ornaments, rainbow tinsel, vintage-style C9 lights, a winking ceramic Santa and a gingerbread snow globe mug.
intro: My grandma had a ceramic Christmas tree with the little plastic bulbs, and every December it sat on her kitchen hutch next to a Santa who looked like he knew something. I wanted that exact feeling back without hunting estate sales. So the hutch got the full retro treatment: the glowing ceramic tree, big old-school C9 bulbs, rainbow tinsel, a bowl of bright ornaments, a winking Santa and a gingerbread mug for cocoa. It looks like 1978 in the best way.

sections.heading: The glow
paragraphs: The Best Choice Products 15 inch pre-lit ceramic Christmas tree in green with multicolor bulbs, and the Holiday Time 25-count vintage-style C9 string lights in ceramic multicolor.

sections.heading: The sparkle and the fun
paragraphs: The Holiday Time 24-count shatterproof ball ornaments in red, green, blue and pink, the Holiday Time multicolor tinsel garland, the Holiday Time ceramic winking Santa and the Holiday Time gingerbread man mug with a snow globe lid.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The hutch, plates, cookies and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
